_notes: Short Ironman training suggestions used when the guide inserts a 'Train X' step. Each entry applies from its level until the next entry. Keep these generic; link out to the wiki for detail.

Attack: Waterfall Quest XP, then sand crabs / ammonite crabs
Strength: Waterfall Quest XP, then sand crabs / ammonite crabs
Hitpoints: Trains with combat — no separate grind
Ranged: Crabs with the best arrows/darts you can make
Magic: Strike/bolt spells on crabs; splashing for AFK
Prayer: Bury bones from Slayer; Ectofuntus with dragon bones
Wyrm/dragon bones at the Ectofuntus or a gilded altar
Runecraft: Lumbridge/Varrock altars, then the Guardians of the Rift minigame
Construction: Crates and chairs from planks; Mahogany Homes
Herblore: Potions from farmed herbs and Slayer drops; Miscellania herbs
Crafting: Leather, then glassblowing with self-made molten glass
Battlestaves from the Varrock diary shop
Fletching: Arrow shafts, then unstrung bows from your own logs
Slayer: Duradel / Nieve with ancients for burst tasks
Mining: Copper/tin → iron in the Mining Guild
Smithing: Quest XP (Knight's Sword) then smithing your own bars
Cooking: Cook everything you fish and the Wintertodt/Tempoross catches
Farming: Tree and fruit tree runs; herb runs from Farming 9
Tithe Farm for the herb sack and seed box
